customManagers.description: ARG WRITEFREELY_FORK_VERSION, the build of divbast's fork of WriteFreely that app/go.mod's replace links, which names the image's version and its extra tag. The fork's release workflow tags each build v0.17.3-divbast.N. Semver versioning orders 0.17.3-divbast.8 above 0.17.3-divbast.7, where docker versioning would read -divbast.N as a fixed variant and offer nothing.

packageRules.description: Every Go module moves, the ones WriteFreely needs as well as the ones it names: Renovate leaves indirect modules alone unless told.

A major that changes an indirect module's path can never apply. Go names v2 and later by path, github.com/writeas/go-writeas/v3 beside .../v2 and gopkg.in/yaml.v3 beside gopkg.in/yaml.v2, so the new major is a separate module that only WriteFreely's own code could import. Tidy drops it and falls back to the lowest release of the old path the graph needs, which downgrades it: go-writeas went from v2.1.1 to v2.0.2 that way. A major keeps its path only from v0 to v1, and between +incompatible releases, which have no go.mod; those still move, as do minor and patch releases. A new major reaches the image when WriteFreely moves to it, through the writefreely-fork PR.

The other Go modules' minor, patch and digest updates in one PR; every Go update runs go mod tidy, set above, majors included: Renovate skips tidy on a major unless gomodUpdateImportPaths is set beside it, which also rewrites this module's own imports of a module whose major changes its path. Only app/ has a go.sum for tidy: the root module, whose replace names ./.ci, has none, so Renovate updates no artifacts there. WriteFreely's require moves by hand and its fork in its own PR, and divbast/ci never through gomod; the go line is no module, and keeps the preset's Dashboard approval. Majors arrive one by one, and automerge.

github.com/go-ini/ini ends at v1.67.0: from v1.67.1 its go.mod declares the module path gopkg.in/ini.v1, so no later release can be required by this path, and a PR proposing one could never build. WriteFreely's config package and SaveConfig both import it by this path. A later release reaches it only when WriteFreely moves to gopkg.in/ini.v1, through the writefreely-fork PR.

github.com/writeas/saturday stays below v2.0.0. That tag is blackfriday's, from 2017, inherited when saturday forked it, on a line that split from saturday's 193 commits before the fork point, so v2.0.0+incompatible would swap saturday for another library. Renovate also looks it up as a tag named v2.0.0+incompatible, finds none, and then makes no update at all. Without that offer, saturday, which has no release after v1.7.1 and which WriteFreely requires at a later commit, moves by commit to the head of its master branch in the Go modules group.

dhi.io/static, the runtime, names its tags by date, as 20250419-debian13, and docker versioning reads the date as the major version, so a newer dated tag is a major increment in the thousands. Renovate's default maxMajorIncrement of 500 would skip it without a word, and the runtime's CA certificates and time zones would stay on the old tag once Docker stops rebuilding it. 0 lifts the limit for this image alone, so a new dated tag on the same line, -debian13, arrives as a pull request like any other update.

app/go.mod's require of github.com/writefreely/writefreely names the release divbast's fork builds on, and keeps the module path every import uses; the replace fetches the fork in its place. It moves by hand, together with the Containerfile's WRITEFREELY_VERSION, when the fork moves to a new upstream release. WriteFreely's releases reach the image through the fork, in the writefreely-fork group below.

app/go.mod's replace of github.com/aryonoco/writefreely looks up the fork's builds where WRITEFREELY_FORK_VERSION does, its git tags, so both are offered the same build. The Go module proxy lists a new tag a while after the fork's release workflow pushes it, so through the proxy the Containerfile was offered the new build and the replace the one before, in one PR whose build fails. The tags keep their v here, as go.mod writes it. Semver orders the builds, as for the ARG.

A build of divbast's fork in one PR: the Containerfile's WRITEFREELY_FORK_VERSION and app/go.mod's replace of github.com/aryonoco/writefreely, with go.sum, since the build fails unless they name the same build. Only tags ending in -divbast.N are offered, since the fork's own builds are the only ones the image takes: another tag in the fork's repository, such as an upstream release tag brought over by a sync, is no build of the fork. It merges once every check passes, like every other update here.
